methodology: Independent Spanish review of all 50 definitions, examples, citation forms, register and provisional placement. DLE pages were opened through web; missing phrase/specialist senses were checked against primary institutional sources. Source support is semantic, not a licensed import or official CEFR assignment. Production term/component and related-sense searches used /tmp/wordfold-c2-existing.json; differences in spelling alone do not establish a new sense. No claim that every possible production synonym was exhaustively discovered.
placementAssessment: All retained entries are at most provisional C2 practice selections. Formality, rarity and idiomaticity do not alone establish exclusive C2 levels. Several ordinary idioms could reasonably be taught earlier; the rationale can support advanced contextual practice but cannot certify lexical level. No official entry-level C1/C2 contradiction was verified in this review.
